meta.title: Watchtower Capital — Next-gen investors in America's entrepreneurs and family-owned businesses
meta.description: Watchtower Capital is a Charlotte private equity firm making control investments, preferably alongside sellers, in founder and family-owned commercial services, consumer services and B2B products businesses.

lede: Watchtower partners with founder-led and family-owned businesses, offering a fresh, hands-on approach to investing built on trust, entrepreneurial spirit and next-generation leadership.

thesis.text: We built our careers at leading private equity firms, then left our suits and egos in New York. We value personal relationships, entrepreneurial spirit and a roll-up-your-sleeves attitude above bureaucracy.

stats.k: Years of private equity and operations experience
Capital invested by the senior team in over 75 transactions
Private and public company board of director seats

steps.title: A control partner, alongside you.
steps.text: We take a controlling stake, preferably alongside sellers, and strongly encourage owners to invest with us. Every seller wants something different, and we help with compensation and transition plans.

steps.title: Partner-level attention.
steps.text: We supplement C-suite and VP-level management with functional experts, build sales teams, professionalize IT and the back office, and bring audit-ready reporting.

steps.title: New markets, new lines.
steps.text: We enter new geographies and service lines, run greenfield de-novo programs, and execute and integrate add-on acquisitions, as with Ally Services and Fence Builders.

focusIntro: Playbooks, operating resources and networks across commercial services, consumer services and B2B products, for family and founder-owned businesses in the United States.

criteria.v: $10 million to $100 million through the life of a platform (the initial investment may be under $10 million).
Revenue up to $100 million; EBITDA up to $10 million.
Strong margins and free cash flow, recession-resistant demand drivers, and a growing, fragmented industry.

sectorsText: Commercial services, consumer services and B2B products.
models: Enter new geographies and service or product lines
pillars: Our principals were trained by some of the best operationally hands-on investors in private equity.
We partner only with founders and families with whom we share mutual respect and a vision.
We seek to understand every aspect of a business, not just the dollars and cents.
Fewer eggs in our basket, monitored closely, with partner-level attention for every investment.

teamIntro: Three managing partners who began their careers together at Sun Capital Partners, with an associate and four operating advisors.

team.name: Will Keesler
team.title: Managing Partner
team.sum: Formerly a Managing Director at Cortec Group; earlier at Paine Schwartz Partners, Sun Capital Partners and Macquarie Capital.
bio: Will is a Managing Partner at Watchtower Capital. Along with his partners, he directs all aspects of the firm's activities, including strategy, investor relations, recruiting and culture, new investment execution and managing the portfolio.

Will has extensive experience leading private equity investments and has served on the Board of Directors of numerous leading middle-market companies. Prior to Watchtower, Will was a Managing Director at Cortec Group, where he focused on investing in family and founder-owned businesses in the consumer services, commercial services and B2B product sectors. Prior to Cortec, Will was a Principal at Paine Schwartz Partners, and previously worked at Sun Capital Partners and Macquarie Capital.

Will received a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from the University of North Carolina. A North Carolina native, he is glad to be home after nearly 20 years in the Northeast and South Florida.

team.name: Casey Lanza
team.title: Managing Partner
team.sum: Formerly a Principal at Instar Asset Management and a Vice President at Sun Capital Partners.
bio: Casey is a Managing Partner at Watchtower. Along with his partners, he directs all aspects of the firm's activities, including strategy, investor relations, recruiting and culture, new investment execution and managing the portfolio.

Casey has extensive experience leading private equity investments and has served on the Board of Directors of numerous leading middle-market companies. Prior to Watchtower, Casey was a Principal at Instar Asset Management, where he focused on investing in leading middle-market essential service businesses and served on the firm's investment committee. Before Instar, Casey was a Vice President at Sun Capital Partners, where he joined as an Operations Analyst focused on portfolio company special projects before moving to the investment team. Earlier he was a Financial Analyst at Waste Industries.
Casey received a Bachelor of Accounting from Florida Atlantic University.

team.name: Mike Minchella
team.title: Managing Partner
team.sum: Formerly a Vice President at Sun Capital Partners and Stellex Capital Management; earlier at Houlihan Lokey.
bio: Mike is a Managing Partner at Watchtower. Along with his partners, he directs all aspects of the firm's activities, including strategy, investor relations, recruiting and culture, new investment execution and managing the portfolio.

Mike has extensive experience leading private equity investments and has served on the Board of Directors of several leading middle-market companies. Prior to Watchtower, Mike was a Vice President at Sun Capital Partners, where he invested in and managed family and founder-owned companies in the home services, industrial services and specialty distribution sectors. Mike also served as Vice President at Stellex Capital Management and previously worked at Houlihan Lokey and Solomon Partners.
Mike received a Bachelor of Business Administration from the University of Michigan.

team.name: Whit Edwards, Jr.
team.title: Associate
team.sum: Formerly an Associate in investment banking at Stephens Inc.
bio: Whit is an Associate at Watchtower Capital, where he supports all aspects of the firm's investment activities, including sourcing and evaluating new opportunities, executing new investments, and managing the portfolio.

Prior to Watchtower, Whit was an Associate in the Investment Banking group at Stephens Inc., where he advised middle-market companies on M&A transactions in the commercial services, consumer services and specialty distribution sectors. He joined Stephens as an Analyst in its generalist program and was promoted to Associate on the Diversified Industrials and Services team.
Whit received a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

team.name: Steuart Botchford
team.title: Operating Advisor
team.sum: Founder and longtime CEO of Northstar Fertility; now a search fund and lower middle-market investor.
bio: Steuart Botchford is an experienced entrepreneur and investor with a deep track record in building and scaling businesses in the consumer service and healthcare sectors. He started his career at Bain & Company, working on private equity and hedge fund diligence.

He then founded and was the longtime CEO of Northstar Fertility, a leading network of fertility and family-building companies, which he led through rapid growth and an eventual sale to private equity. Steuart then moved from operator to investor, focusing on search funds and lower middle-market businesses, and serves on multiple boards. He brings particular expertise in consumer services, specialty insurance and strategic M&A.
Steuart holds a bachelor's degree in Philosophy and Economics from Mercer University and an MBA and MS from the University of Michigan.

team.name: Nick Coder
team.title: Operating Advisor
team.sum: President of Fence Builders; co-founder of StonePoint Materials.
bio: Nick Coder is a business executive with over 20 years of experience building leading businesses through strategic growth and M&A in private equity and public company settings. He is currently the President of Fence Builders, Inc.

Previously, he co-founded StonePoint Materials, a top 25 U.S. construction aggregates company, where he drove value creation through M&A and growth initiatives as Vice President of Business Development before the company's acquisition by Arcosa. Before StonePoint, Nick spent nearly 10 years as an investment banker for middle market companies.
Nick received a Bachelor of Arts from Duke University and a Master of Finance from Penn State University, and is a CFA Charterholder.

team.name: Daniel Miller
team.title: Operating Advisor
team.sum: Former President of A1 Garage Door Services; two decades across home services, healthcare and technology.
bio: Dan Miller is a seasoned business executive with over two decades of experience driving growth and operational excellence across founder-led and private equity-backed businesses, with leadership roles in strategy, finance and operations in home services, healthcare and technology.

He began his career in operations and engineering roles at FedEx Express and DHL. Most recently, Dan served as President of A1 Garage Door Services, where he played an instrumental role in transforming a fast-growing, founder-led business into a successful exit to private equity. He serves on several boards and partners with founders and management teams on investment, growth and exit opportunities.
Dan holds a bachelor's degree in Industrial and Operations Engineering from the University of Michigan and an MBA from the Ross School of Business.

team.name: Jack Walter
team.title: Operating Advisor
team.sum: Former Chief Financial Officer of VCA, Inc. and of Companion Pet Partners.
bio: Jack Walter is a business executive with over 30 years of experience leading finance and accounting organizations in private equity and public company settings.

Jack previously served as Chief Financial Officer at VCA, Inc., one of the world's largest providers of veterinary care, with more than 1,000 veterinary hospitals across the U.S. and Canada. He worked at VCA for over 20 years, ultimately guiding the company through its sale to Mars Inc. in 2017. Jack also served as Chief Financial Officer of Companion Pet Partners, a veterinary hospital operator in the Western U.S. built through acquisition.
Jack received a Bachelor's degree from the Perdue School of Business at Salisbury University.
